name: PCI-DSS Segmentation Testing
description: Validate that the Cardholder Data Environment (CDE) is completely isolated.

items.guidance: Cross-examine the client asset inventory against live systems to confirm all CDE machines are accounted for.
Map all zones: CDE, Connected-to/Impacting, and Out-of-Scope.
TCP/UDP scans from Out-of-Scope networks into the CDE to verify no open ingress.
Ping CDE hosts from non-CDE zones to verify routers/firewalls drop the requests.
Attempt source-IP-spoofed routing to cross the segmentation boundary.
From within the CDE, attempt outbound Internet connections; only authorized endpoints should be reachable.
From Connected-to systems (jump boxes, DCs), attempt to pivot into the CDE on unapproved ports.
Packet-capture shared boundaries to confirm PAN/track data never leaks to non-CDE zones in cleartext.
Confirm ACLs follow strict default-deny for all non-essential traffic touching the CDE.
